concept_dispositions.scope: Concern-specific atomic reserve, beginAttempt, recordOutcome, markTransportSettled and inspect contract over scope/key and versioned canonical request fingerprint. Reserve gives one opaque execution token or replay/conflict/in-progress/failure outcome. At most one attempt per token. Outcome and transport settlement are independent; retention begins only after both. Pending records never expire or evict. Capacity rejection precedes execution. Bounded memory v1 stores no restart or cross-host guarantee and requires no outbox event.

concept_dispositions.scope: Candidate Node HTTP composition record, equal by service id/version and declared fields: routes, typed function references, pure bounded query iteration, runtime dependency references and explicit limits. It describes a service build and grants no listener, provider-call or tenant authority. Routes are unique method/path pairs; unknown fields, targets and unresolved references reject.

concept_dispositions.scope: Map an allowlisted typed failure code to configured HTTP status and a bounded body {request_id?,error:{code}}; unknown internal diagnostics become INTERNAL_ERROR. No exception message, binding identity, URL, credential or provider response body appears. Once SSE has started, the same sanitized code enters its terminal error envelope instead of changing HTTP status.

concept_dispositions.scope: Concern-specific sendOnce contract accepts one resolved binding id/version and validated JSON body plus invocation control. The operator resolver privately supplies exact destination and secret reference. It yields bounded status/media metadata and a byte source with cancel and transport-settlement observation. No redirect, automatic retry, client URL, secret in authored source or inferred remote cancellation success. Raw provider JSON need not carry Alch business status.

concept_dispositions.scope: Evaluate a named pure item query over a previously materialized finite list in stable input order, at most max_items, concurrency one, within the parent deadline and aggregate output limit. All-or-error: no partial discovery response. No operation, raw HTTP binding, recursion, unbounded collection or hidden effect is allowed. Reuses existing per-alias mappings and aggregates; no inference-specific primitive.

concept_dispositions.scope: One closed method/path binding to a named function, JSON/no-body input, JSON or request-selected JSON/SSE output and named error policy. V1 GET has no body and POST requires JSON. Before stream start, failures are JSON; afterwards only one terminal stream event may be attempted while writable. Authentication and authorization are explicitly deferred in this candidate shared-public scope.

concept_dispositions.owner_route: Alch product and DomainSpec implementation owners
concept_dispositions.scope: Concern-specific start, delta, complete, fail and cancel delivery contract. Writes await backpressure. Identity is pinned at start. Parsing remains byte-adapter work; mapped deltas and completion are declarative. One local terminal transition; terminal emission is attempted only while writable, and transport settlement is separate from terminal delivery.

concept_dispositions.owner_route: Alch product and DomainSpec implementation owners
concept_dispositions.scope: Created transitions on start to open, or on failure/cancellation to failed/cancelled. Open accepts deltas and transitions once to completed/failed/cancelled. Terminal states accept no further transition. Failure before start is an HTTP JSON error; after start it is an SSE error while writable. Cancellation or an incomplete response does not prove remote execution stopped.

No frozen baseline mutation or live provider.
